subject: Integration performance handoff: acceptance criteria & load plan
messages:
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Amar Joshi <amar@greenline.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 22 Jul 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Integration performance handoff: acceptance criteria & load plan

Hi Amar —

Thanks for the quick sync yesterday. Per our onboarding playbook, I wanted to send a concise acceptance checklist and the proposed load test plan so your team can confirm feasibility ahead of the test window. High level acceptance targets we recommend for the first acceptance run: 

- Throughput target: sustained 120 requests/sec (concurrent inference requests) for the user-facing chat endpoint during steady-state.
- Tail latency: p95 < 350ms, p99 < 700ms (single-token generation measurement).
- Error budget: <0.5% 5xx / connection errors during the steady-state window.
- Successful end-to-end SLA: 95% of user flows complete without fallback to alternative model variants.

Test plan (attached: greenline-onboard-loadplan-v1.xlsx):
1) Environment prep: provide staging endpoint URL, auth creds, and VPC/egress constraints by EOD Tue (we need to check routing).
2) Baseline run: 15m light ramp to verify health checks and KV cache priming.
3) Ramp to steady-state: 10m linear ramp to 120 rps, hold 30m.
4) Spike test: 5x short burst to validate graceful degradation.
5) Capture: token-level latency, per-request cost, trace IDs, and system metrics (GPU util, memory, network).

Ben attached the load scripts we'll use (redwood-load-scripts-v2.zip) and a results CSV template (initial-results-template.csv) — Ben: can you confirm the ramp profile and any required client flags?

Ask from GreenLine: please confirm the staging hostname, an ops contact for live troubleshooting, and any rate-limiting or egress proxies that might change the observed latency.

Proposed test window: Thu Jul 25, 09:00–11:00 PT. If that works, we’ll lock and send a shared Runbook doc with zoom + Slack channel.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

- Our target for the initial acceptance run is aligned with your throughput target but we may need to cap bursts to 3x (not 5x) due to downstream fraud checks.

Security ask: can you also attach an export of the audit log format we'll receive (audit field names) and confirm logs will be retained for 90 days for this evaluation?

We can confirm Thu Jul 25 09:00–11:00 PT but will plan to have our SREs on call and Lisa (cc'd) will own the ops coordination.

Folks —

I've attached the client harness and the exact ramp profile in redwood-load-scripts-v2.zip. Short summary of the load script behavior here: 

- Client nodes: 8 workers (simulated concurrency), each opens 50 concurrent connections (total ~400 connections).
- Ramp: 10m linear from 10 rps -> 120 rps total.
- Steady-state: hold 30m at 120 rps.
- Spike: 3x burst for 90s (per GreenLine request) then back to steady-state.
- Payloads: we will use the "production-ish" payload set (avg 320 tokens, p95 780 tokens) — files included under payloads/ in the ZIP.

I'll be on the run and will post live metrics to the shared Drive link. If you want a read-only Grafana link during the run, call it out and I’ll generate one.
